page.overview:
What is Louse?

Louse, plurally known as Lice, was the name given to a species of primitive parasitic insects native to Fiorina "Fury" 161.

Native to the planetoid Fiorina 161, lice fed voraciously on the keratin in human hair; however, they had no interest in fingernails. As a result, all local personnel were forced to continually shave their heads and bodies.

The lice in were portrayed by cricket nymphs. The tiny creatures got everywhere, including inside the Xenomorph suit worn by Tom Woodruff, Jr., causing the effects artist much discomfort during filming. The nymphs also infested the ox puppet used to portray Babe in the abattoir scenes from the extended Special Edition, and when Amalgamated Dynamics, Inc. took the puppet out of storage several weeks after filming, they found the creatures were still alive and had since grown to full size.
